name: SikaTile®-305 Master Lite
tagline: A HYBRID LIGHT WEIGHT POLYMER FORTIFIED TILE ADHESIVE
summary: SikaTile®-305 Master Lite is a hybrid light weight polymer fortified tile adheisve suitable for internal and external applications including residential pools and spas on both wall and floor substrates.
metaDescription: SikaTile®-305 Master Lite is a hybrid light weight polymer fortified tile adheisve suitable for internal and external applications including residential pools and spas on both wall and floor substrates.
attributes: White colour - colour may vary dependant on local sand source.
usage: SikaTile®-305 Master Lite can be used as a thin-bed tile adhesive for the following applications,
Suitable Sika waterproofing membranes designed to receive direct fixed tile
Existing Ceramic tiles (primed with Sikafloor-14 Prep N Prime Impact)
other suitable construction boards designed to receive tiles*
* refer to board manufacturers strict instructions for further details and load limits
Stone not sensitive to moisture and dimensionally stable
advantages: White colour - colour may vary dependant on local sand source.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: If unopened 12 months from date of manufacture.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text:
Store in dry cool conditions, off ground out of direct sunlight.
High humidity will reduce shelf life.

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text: 5.5 - 6 Litres of clean cool potable water per 15kg bag

items.label: Pot Life
items.text:
2 hours at 23° degrees and 50% relative humidity.
Adhesive may need restirring during its pot life. Restir without adding any additional water.

items.label: Open Time
items.text: 30 minutes at 23°C degrees and 50% relative humidity

items.label: Applied product ready for use
items.text:
Application | Wait Time
Grouting and light foot traffic | 24 Hours
Wet Area Service | 5 Days
Submerged Applications ie pools | 21 Days
* Wait times are tested at 23°C and 50% relative humidity and should be used as a guide only.
Hot climates reduce wait times, and cool or cold climates will extend wait times.

items.label: Consumption
items.text:
7.5m2 with a 10mm notched trowel
Coverage is dependant of surface profile and application technique.

items.label: EQUIPMENT
items.text:
Personal protective equipment
Mixing drill with stirrer attachment
Clean mixing buckets
Trowels

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text:
All surfaces must be installed according to manufacturer’s instructions and or relevant Australian Standard(s) and be structurally sound, dry, clean and free from movement, oil, grease, wax, sealers, curing compounds, release agents and any other loose or contaminating material. Thoroughly clean old surfaces, or new surfaces that have been treated, prior to tiling.
Deeply contaminated surfaces must be prepared/abraded to a clean, sound surface. Expose at least 80% of the original substrate of painted surfaces. Substrates shall meet relevant deflection standards outlined in the relevant Australian Standards (AS3958).
CONCRETE SUBSTRATES:
New concrete shall be 14 days old and be left with a wood float finish.
Steel trowel finished concrete is generally acceptable if the concrete allows water penetration.
Concrete above 35MPa shall be mechanically prepared.
CEMENT BOARD AND SHEETING:
All boards and sheets must be fixed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and specifically designed for tiling.
SCREEDS & MORTAR BEDS:
Sand cement screeds must be installed as per relevant Australian Standards and left for a minimum 24 hours prior to tiling. Screeds may need longer drying time in cold climates.
TILE ON TILE APPLICATIONS:
Ensure all existing tiles are firmly fixed, loose or hollow tiles must be removed and the area repaired using a suitable Sika repair mortar. Existing tiles shall be adequately cleaned prior to the application of the primer. Existing tiles shall be primed with Sikafloor-14 Prep N Prime Impact and allowed to dry prior to tiling.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text:
All surfaces except waterproofing membranes shall be primed prior to application.
Priming Guide:
Application | Primer
Porous & Dense substrates | SikaTile 010 Secure prime
Non-porous substrates and Tile on tile | Sikafloor-14 Prep n Prime Impact
Refer to the relevant product data sheet for the primer for additional information.

items.label: MIXING
items.text:
Measure recommended amount of clean cool potable water and slowing add the SikaTile®-305 Master Lite powder. Gradually stir the mixture untill it reaches a smooth lump free consistency (approximately 2 minutes).
Allow the mixture to stand or "slake" for 3-5 minutes then restir for an additional minute without add any aditional water.
Restiring during the adhesives pot life may be required, do not add any additional water, restir only.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Tiles shall be fixed in accordance with Australian Standards.
Ensure the back of tiles are from dust and contaminates.
Apply the adhesive with a notched trowel to the substrate to achieve minimum coverage requirement outlined in the relevant Australian Standards.
Adhesive notches should be applied in a single direction.
Apply tiles into the wet adhesive and break the adhesive notches to fully bed the tile in the adhesive layer. Ensure adequate coverage outlined in the Australlian Standards is achieved to both substrate and the back of tiles.
Tiles 400x400 and larger shall be back buttered as per relevant Australian Standards.
Clean excess adhesive out of the grout joints while the adhesive is still wet.
Allow the adhesive to dry and set prior to grouting.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text:
Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water prior to the adhesive setting.
Adhesive that has set will require mechanical removal.
